data.text: **Question:** Explain Entity Framework Core and its approaches.
EF Core is an ORM for .NET. Supports Database-First, Code-First, and Model-First approaches. Code-First is most common with migrations.
EF Core maps objects to database tables. Code-First defines models in code and generates database. Database-First generates models from existing database. Migrations track schema changes.
